purpose: Calibrate and reproduce graph temporal representation dimension measurements, then test recurrence and modality generality.

approval.note: The user is willing to approve Compute Canada work. No specific allocation or racing plan has been approved.

nodes.deliverable: Source-located claim ledger distinguishing preliminary graph findings, mathematical assumptions, measurement definitions, and unsupported interpretations.
acceptance: Every claim has a source path/location and an evidence level.
Discrete period-map analysis is separated from continuous-time embedding claims.
State completeness, reference orbit closure, forcing, numerical tolerances, and rank estimands are specified or explicitly unresolved.
Missing executable code, raw measurements, checkpoints, and data are recorded.

nodes.note: Local synthetic infrastructure passed nine tests and ten calibration checks; graph adapter/JVP/chronology and frozen graph-pilot measurement contract remain required for this milestone. Synthetic checks are not graph reproduction.
nodes.deliverable: CPU fixtures and a reviewed measurement contract covering trajectory dimension, periodic Jacobian products, numerical validity, and estimator limitations.
acceptance: Known-rank and degenerate covariance fixtures expose centering and finite-sample behavior.
Known diagonal and noncommuting period maps validate product order and spectrum.
Non-normal transient behavior is distinguished from asymptotic eigenvalue stability.
Saved arrays reproduce reported metrics and all verification checks pass.
Measurement thresholds, state definition, and uncertainty unit are frozen for the graph pilot.

blockers: Executable graph training/analysis code, source-linked checkpoints, and raw datasets have not been recovered in this repository.
nodes.deliverable: Hash-pinned inventory of graph code, dataset generator/splits, trained model configuration, checkpoint and analysis outputs; document reconstruction deviations.
acceptance: Code repository/commit and environment are identified or absence is recorded.
Graph generator, train/validation/test identities, seeds, task period, state layout, and checkpoint provenance are known.
A forward pass and complete-state extraction can be demonstrated on authorized local inputs.
No figure is presented as a newly reproduced result.

nodes.deliverable: Version-verified Cluv submission/racing plan for configured Mila/Tamia/other Compute Canada targets, with commands, resource limits and artifact retrieval ready for user approval.
acceptance: Installed Cluv version and supported flags are checked against official sources and the actual CLI.
Cluster/account availability and project paths are verified without assuming entitlement.
Concrete commands/configs and total race/concurrency limits are reviewable.
No GPU jobs or externally allocated resources are launched before applicable approval.

blockers: Measurements and assets must be verified.
Cluster execution additionally requires a concrete approved resource envelope.
nodes.deliverable: Source-matched graph pilot with saved complete recurrent trajectories, period maps, dimension estimates, forcing/control conditions, task performance, and seed-level results.
acceptance: Protocol, tolerances, discovery/selection rules and seeds are fixed before held-out evaluation.
Orbit closure and input/Jacobian periodicity are tested; failures retain finite-window labels.
Low rank and contraction are reported as separate estimands with performance and forcing controls.
Artifacts satisfy provenance/schema/checksum contracts, and missing/failed replications remain visible.

nodes.deliverable: Evidence-based supported, unsupported or inconclusive decision for a precisely scoped graph dimension-collapse claim, plus bounded next protocol.
acceptance: Task/state/seed population and uncertainty limitations are explicit.
Periodic forcing, sampling rank ceilings, state scaling, and non-normal transients are considered.
Negative results are retained; scientific rejection does not trigger repeat-until-positive runs.

nodes.deliverable: Small falsifiable cross-modal pilot protocols sharing calibrated estimands and appropriate modality-specific state/task controls; execution is a new bounded plan revision.
acceptance: Pilot selection follows verified graph evidence, including negative findings.
State completeness, task performance, horizon and complexity matching are explicit.
Data sources/licenses, model provenance, expected costs and approval needs are documented.
Generalization claims distinguish modalities, tasks, models, and independent training seeds.
